name: FERC eLibrary
known_limitations: FERC filings and orders are docket evidence, but they require docket selection, procedural context, and careful distinction between proposals, protests, orders, and compliance filings.
automation_notes: Use for transmission, interconnection, market, rate, LNG, hydro, and electric reliability docket evidence.
notes: Core power-docket rail before making stronger grid or utility claims. Phase 55E live recheck reached the interactive search application; docket selection and procedural interpretation remain manual.
